The effect drops when nitrogen fertilizer is applied (Zhao et al. 2022). It is not added to the income above.

strings.Haba se siembra en unas 398 ha del distr: Fava bean is planted on about 398 ha in the district: 1.0% of what is planted to maize (about 39,493 ha). Its yield and income come from those few fields, which may have more moisture, supplemental irrigation or better soil than yours. Read it as what those who already plant it achieve, not as what your field would yield.
strings.Hay canícula: julio-agosto llueve menos: There is a canícula (midsummer dry spell): July-August is rainier less than June and September.

Wheat (autumn-winter, irrigated): in the Cortazar district there are 23 years of records and about 41,633 ha planted per year. It yields 6.84 t per planted ha (last 10 years, counting what is lost) at $6,505/t (average farm-gate price, last 5 years).

Wheat (autumn-winter, irrigated): in the Los Mochis district there are 23 years of records and about 34,659 ha planted per year. It yields 5.86 t per planted ha (last 10 years, counting what is lost) at $6,426/t (average farm-gate price, last 5 years).
